correlate.executive_summary: The assessment discovered a mix of informational and low-to-medium risk issues on https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com/. A discoverable /ftp path (also referenced in robots.txt) returned HTTP 200 and should be reviewed for sensitive content. Several security headers that harden browsers (HSTS, CSP, Referrer-Policy) are not present, while numerous platform/reporting headers and a permissive CORS value were observed. No matching CVE entries were available for detected services/versions, so no severity/confidence was upgraded based on CVEs.

correlate.deduplication_notes: Merged recon and nikto findings that described the same underlying issue: the /ftp path was reported by recon (HTTP 200) and by nikto (file/dir '/ftp/' returned 200) — these were combined into a single /ftp finding. The robots.txt entries reported by recon and nikto were also merged. Multiple nikto observations of response headers were grouped into two findings: a single grouping for the permissive CORS header and a separate grouping for other uncommon/extra headers; missing security headers reported by recon were left as a separate finding (not merged) because nikto did not contradict their absence.
